lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows on the lateral flank, exhibiting a semi-regular grid-like distribution posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadowed transition on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally and slightly posterior to the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
